per_case_results.question: Which publisher created more superheroes: DC or Marvel Comics? Find the difference in the number of superheroes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    MAX("superhero_count") - MIN("superhero_count") AS "difference",
    MAX("superhero_count") AS "max_count",
    MIN("superhero_count") AS "min_count",
    (
        SELECT "publisher_name"
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                p."publisher_name",
                COUNT(s."id") AS "superhero_count"
            FROM "superhero" s
            INNER JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
            WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
            GROUP BY p."publisher_name"
            ORDER BY "superhero_count" DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS top
    ) AS "top_publisher"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p."publisher_name",
        COUNT(s."id") AS "superhero_count"
    FROM "superhero" s
    INNER JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
    WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p."publisher_name"
) AS counts
